description: This file defines a utility class 'AttendanceEnumerations' that provides methods to convert AttendanceType enum values into EnumOptionData objects for use in the application. It includes methods to get enumeration data for individual attendance types and lists of types, with filtering to exclude invalid types.

classes.name: AttendanceEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to convert attendance enum values into EnumOptionData representations, facilitating UI display and data mapping.

methods.name: attendanceType(int)
methods.description: Converts an integer representing attendance type to its EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: attendanceType(AttendanceType)
methods.description: Converts an AttendanceType enum instance to its EnumOptionData representation.

methods.name: attendanceType(AttendanceType[])
methods.description: Converts an array of AttendanceType enums into a list of EnumOptionData, excluding invalid attendance types.
